label: Major label royalty deal
note: UK CMA (primary): average major-label royalty 19.7% (2012) to 23.3% (2021). The ends of the range are not the CMA's: superstar renegotiations reach about 30% (press reports, B); the 15% low end (older and first-deal contracts) is our assumption, not sourced

label: Independent label
note: Wide: from 40% (1501 kept 60%, court filing) to label-services terms near 80%

label: Deal unknown
note: No label on record: anything from a major royalty to keeping 100% as a DIY artist

label: Label services / major distribution
note: AWAL Core: the artist keeps 85%; other services take 15-30%

label: Self-released through a distributor
note: UnitedMasters free tier: 90%; paid tiers and DistroKid: 100%; some distributors take up to 15%
